Claim 1 (Currently amended): An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the alignment device is configured to utilize a dynamic user interface that adapts based on the alignment.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment and provides feedback to the user interface.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in visually emphasizing the current step on the user interface.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification and user interaction.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment and user input.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in visually emphasizing the next step on the user interface.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification and user interaction.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, including user feedback.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images and user feedback to calculate the alignment.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure and user feedback.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, including user feedback.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device and user interaction.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images and user feedback to calculate the alignment.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure and user feedback.

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment and user interaction.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in visually emphasizing the current step on the user interface.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment and user input.

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in visually emphasizing the next step on the user interface.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, including user feedback.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device and user feedback.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure and user feedback.

Claim 26 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure, including user feedback.

Claim 28 (Currently amended): A method for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the method comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric; visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment and user interaction; and automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment and user interaction.

Claim 30 (Currently amended): The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device and user feedback.

Claim 31 (Currently amended): The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure and user feedback.
